notes: Income bands are monthly wages in Nexora Credits, design v1 — Unit F (economy GDD) owns final tuning. playable_in_v1 marks the three professions the master plan (Part C #11, Phase 6) makes playable first; all others are NPC-run until later phases. workplace_zone values are GDD-02 district ids.

professions.gameplay_summary: Physical site work on staged builds; the labour backbone of the Civil Engineer loop. NPC-run in v1; a natural future playable entry job.
professions.name: Construction Worker
professions.workplace: Construction sites and the industry-edge yard

professions.gameplay_summary: FLAGSHIP loop (master plan Phase 5): take a job -> produce the plan -> estimate materials (real quantities, priced from the market) -> supervise staged construction -> get paid + reputation. Built from the owner's real profession.
professions.name: Civil Engineer

progression.title: Chief Engineer / Own Firm
progression.unlock: Engineering 85 + capital to register a construction business

professions.starting_example: The owner's example character starts here: Middle Class, 25,000 NCr balance, rented apartment in Nexora Central City (GDD-01 §1, §7).
professions.workplace: Construction site office + staged build plot (District 1 industry edge)

professions.gameplay_summary: Clinic shifts, patient cases as diagnosis puzzles, health events for the district's families. NPC-run in v1 (clinic fully staffed by NPCs); playable in a later phase.
professions.name: Doctor

progression.title: Chief Physician / Own Clinic
progression.unlock: Medicine 90 or capital for a clinic business

professions.gameplay_summary: School-day rhythm profession; anchors the child/teen life stages (their classes are this profession's workplace). NPC-run in v1.
professions.name: Teacher
professions.workplace: District school, Civic Quarter (college lecturers: d1_education)

professions.gameplay_summary: Patrols, market-hours enforcement, incident response. In v1 the police are the visible law system NPCs; the wanted/chase interplay with the player matures in later phases.
professions.name: Police Officer
professions.workplace: Police station, Civic Quarter + patrol routes

professions.gameplay_summary: Playable driving loop: fares with time/traffic trade-offs, vehicle costs and fuel from the ledger, regulars who remember good driving (relationship flags).
professions.name: Taxi Driver
professions.workplace: Taxi/CNG depot, Industry Edge; fares across all zones

professions.gameplay_summary: Kitchen shifts, menu quality driving restaurant revenue, market ingredient runs. NPC-run in v1; the tea stalls and restaurant stay socially important from Phase 5.
professions.name: Chef

progression.title: Chef-Owner
progression.unlock: Capital for own restaurant/tea stall business

professions.gameplay_summary: Highest wage band in the district; project-deadline events, remote days in schedules. NPC-run in v1.
professions.name: Software Developer

progression.title: CTO / Startup Founder
progression.unlock: Programming 85 or register a software business

professions.workplace: Office block, Uptown Heights (some remote-work schedules)

professions.gameplay_summary: Playable business loop: buy stock at wholesale prices, set prices, watch demand by time/weather/footfall, pay rent and staff from the ledger.
professions.income_note: Business income, not a wage: revenue minus stock, rent and staff — can be negative in a bad month (GDD-01 §7: classes move in both directions).
professions.name: Shop Owner
professions.workplace: Own shop unit, Boro Bazar market hall / spine

professions.gameplay_summary: The entrepreneur endgame of the owner's spec: hire employees, open branches, move the district economy. Reached by growing a playable business (Shop Owner / Civil Engineer firm / transport) rather than chosen at start; NPC magnates exist from world seed.
professions.income_note: Pure business income band — widest variance in the game; represents owners of factories, firms and multi-unit businesses (GDD-01 §7 entrepreneur class).
professions.name: Business Owner

progression.title: Industrialist
progression.unlock: Top-decile district net worth + market influence events

professions.workplace: Own company office (Uptown) + owned premises across zones

professions.gameplay_summary: Present in data from v1 so NPC pilots and the profession graph are complete, but the workplace (airport) and flight gameplay arrive with Phase 8 travel. Honest scope: not playable, no District 1 presence beyond residents who commute out.
professions.name: Pilot
professions.workplace: Regional airport (Phase 8 travel content — no airport exists in District 1, GDD-02 §8)
